images.title: Not identical squares
images.purpose: Show a rectangle 7 cm by 2 cm that cannot be split into identical squares because a leftover piece stays.
images.composition: One wide rectangle centred; two teal squares on the left and a plain leftover piece on the right.
images.exact_structure: One rectangle 7 units wide and 2 units tall, outline teal #0072B2. Two squares of side 2 units shaded teal from the left, using 4 units. The remaining piece, 3 units by 2 units, is plain with a dashed grey #6B7280 outline. Bottom labels: 4 cm under the squares, 3 cm left over under the leftover; left side 2 cm. Exactly 1 rectangle, 2 squares, 1 leftover piece.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a leftover drawn as a square
images.takeaway: A leftover piece that is not a square means the rectangle cannot be split into identical squares.
images.description: Rectangle 7 cm by 2 cm with two squares cut from the left and a 3 cm by 2 cm leftover that is not a square.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the leftover and say why it is not a square.

image_decisions.why: One clean geometry picture carries the single idea of this video.
